body:
RXVYSpawners
The Ultimate High-Performance Spawner Management System

RXVYSpawners is a professional-grade Java plugin designed to eliminate the lag and complexity of traditional mob farms. By replacing physical item drops with a sleek virtual storage system and intelligent block stacking, RXVYSpawners provides a modern, "all-in-one" solution for economy-based survival servers.

Key Features
⚡ Intelligent Spawner Stacking
Save space and reduce entity lag by stacking identical spawners into a single block (up to 100x).

📦 Virtualized Loot Storage
Spawners collect loot internally in a virtual "buffer" every 10 seconds, removing the need for laggy hoppers and massive chest arrays.

🖱️ All-In-One Management GUI
A custom-designed menu allows players to collect their items, sell the specific spawner's storage, or sell loot from all nearby spawners in one click.

💰 Integrated Economy Shop
Includes a built-in /spawnershop where players can buy specialized mob types like Iron Golems, Villagers, and Blazes using Vault-compatible currency.

🛠️ Admin-Friendly Tools
Features simple commands for admins to give specific spawners to players and manage server-wide stacking limits.

Why Choose RXVYSpawners?
Most spawner plugins rely on physical drops that can tank server TPS (Ticks Per Second). RXVYSpawners is built from the ground up for rxvysmp.net to ensure that even with thousands of active spawners, your server remains fast and responsive. It’s the perfect choice for server owners who want a professional, "set-it-and-forget-it" farming system that players find easy to use.

Support & Questions
If you have any questions, bug reports, or need support with the installation, please join our official community Discord:
